title: MP Pagors gets warning for speaking Russian inside Saeima building
summary_full: On Wednesday, 11 November, the Saeima’s Provisional Committee on Mandates, Ethics and Petitions decided to issue a written warning to MP Andrejs Pagors (Sovereign Power/Union of New Latvians) for breaching the Code of Ethics for Members of the Saeima.
